title: Shrimp Scampi with Linguine
description: Juicy shrimp in a buttery garlic, lemon and white wine sauce tossed with linguine and parsley. On the table in 25 minutes.

image.alt: A plate of linguine with garlicky shrimp, parsley and lemon

ingredients.scaleNote: Use a big pot of water whatever the batch size.
It seasons the pasta water, which stays the same amount.

steps.text: Bring the water and pasta salt to a boil and cook the linguine until just al dente. Save {qty 1 cup fixed} of the pasta water, then drain.

Meanwhile pat the shrimp dry and season with the salt. Heat the oil and 1 tbsp butter in the skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the shrimp in one layer until pink on the bottom, {time 1 min}, then turn and cook for {time 1 min} more. Move to a plate; they’ll finish in the sauce.
Lower the heat to medium, add the garlic and pepper flakes and stir until the garlic is pale golden, {time 1 min}.
Add the wine and lemon juice and simmer until reduced by half, {time 2 min}. Swirl in the remaining butter.
Add the pasta, shrimp and a splash of pasta water and toss until the sauce is glossy and the shrimp are opaque, {time 1 min}. Toss in the parsley and serve.

notes: Shrimp overcook fast; they’re done as soon as they turn opaque and curl into a loose C shape.
